title: Rowing Fitness Program
subtitle: A progressive endurance framework for rowing fitness program, including intensity, recovery, and monitoring.
evidence_strength: Established evidence from exercise physiology and sports science supports the efficacy of progressive rowing programs to improve endurance and cardiovascular health.
